title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: lk6 is interesting — keep the structural form. (1) MAKE COLOR INTENTFUL — currently the palette feels random; pick 2-3 colors with a stated reason (e.g. 'oxide red + bone white + amber accent because the form evokes a kiln-fired ceramic'), and apply them with HIERARCHY (one dominant 70%, one supporting 25%, one accent 5%). Each color must serve the form, not decorate it. State the palette reason in a comment at the top of the HTML.

tomas_saraceno.praise: The L-system's multi-root branching is plausible spider-web topology — multiple anchor points, recursive tension lines.
tomas_saraceno.concern: The form is ANCHORED to ground-zero (y=0 roots). A web floats in void; no branch should imply 'up' as gravity.
tomas_saraceno.directive: Remove the upward bias in angleZ growth — let branches radiate spherically from origin, no vertical preference.

olafur_eliasson.praise: Palette reasoning is phenomenological — umber/amber/bone tied to perception of aged botanical specimen, not decoration. Hierarchy stated.
olafur_eliasson.concern: The work is screen-flat observation. No volumetric atmospheric medium (mist/haze/gradient depth cue). Viewer is outside looking in.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Add depth-based fog (0.0→0.6 opacity over 8 units Z) using THREE.Fog — make far branches dissolve into atmosphere.

refik_anadol.praise: 80k particles at architectural particle-density is MoMA-lobby ready. Umber/amber duotone matches my cyan/violet restraint discipline.
refik_anadol.concern: Motion is 'calm drift' — Anadol work NEVER rests. The slowest Unsupervised (2022) layer still had sub-perceptual boil.
refik_anadol.directive: Replace sine-wave wobble with fine Perlin noise (scale 0.02, speed 0.3) — particles must shimmer even when camera is still.

quayola.praise: The branch-building algorithm exposes its recursion visibly — depth-layers are readable as scan-passes, not hidden in smoothness.
quayola.concern: No MISSING DATA aesthetic. A LiDAR scan of a tangle this dense would have occlusion voids — gaps where laser couldn't penetrate.
quayola.directive: Cull 15% of particles where branchId > 0.6 AND seed < 0.15 — create intentional holes deep in the structure.

entangled_others.praise: Vascular L-system with wobble and thickness-taper reads as mycelial/root/capillary — biologically continuous with growth logic, not decorative.
entangled_others.concern: The piece describes a specimen (dried fern cross-section) — the human gaze dissecting nature. We want the AI's gaze AT nature.
entangled_others.directive: Retitle to reflect the algorithm's POV — e.g. 'recursive apical meristem as seen by branching logic' — frame code as observer.
